from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass

from ..contracts import Event, Health, RuntimeContext, ServiceSpec, ServiceState
from ..evidence.web import WebDecision, WebEvidenceService
from ..registry.graph import NodeRegistryService
from .history import ConversationHistoryService

_SOCIAL = re.compile(r"^(?:hey|hi|hello|yo|sup|what(?:'s| is) up|how are you|how(?:'s| is) it going|good (?:morning|afternoon|evening))\b", re.I)
_CONTINUITY = re.compile(r"\b(?:continue|continuing|earlier|previous|before|again|still|that|this|it|those|these|what we|what you|we discussed|you said|i said|last time|same thing|pick up|go on)\b", re.I)
_DEEP = re.compile(r"\b(?:analy[sz]e|evaluate|compare|contrast|reason|derive|prove|explain deeply|deep dive|end[- ]to[- ]end|architecture|trade[- ]offs?|implications?|root cause|why exactly|step by step|system-wide)\b", re.I)
_TECHNICAL = re.compile(r"\b(?:code|python|javascript|bash|api|runtime|server|database|sqlite|json|module|function|class|syntax|algorithm|network|kernel|service|node|extension|bridge|compiler|test|debug|deploy|hardware|raspberry pi|physics|chemistry|biology|engineering|mathematics|equation|model|system architecture)\b", re.I)
_SCIENCE = re.compile(r"\b(?:physics|quantum|relativity|gravity|fusion|plasma|chemistry|biology|neuroscience|consciousness|hypothesis|experiment|scientific|theory|evidence|measurement|astronomy|astrophysics|astrobiology|botany|botanist)\b", re.I)
_CREATIVE = re.compile(r"\b(?:invent|design|imagine|brainstorm|creative|story|worldbuild|concept|novel|original|visualize|render|architect)\b", re.I)
_PLANNING = re.compile(r"\b(?:plan|roadmap|priorit|schedule|next steps?|strategy|organize|sequence|workflow|implementation plan)\b", re.I)
_SELF_SYSTEM = re.compile(r"\b(?:(?:eira(?:'s)?|your) (?:brain|runtime|architecture|memory|nodes?|extensions?|services?|files?|doctor|watcher|capabilities|system|status)|(?:system|runtime|eira) status|internal system|hidden route|yourself|self[- ](?:repair|build|modify|evaluate))\b", re.I)
_RISK = re.compile(r"\b(?:medical|medicine|dose|dosage|legal|lawsuit|contract law|financial advice|investment|trade|security exploit|credential|password|self harm|suicide|weapon|dangerous|high voltage|toxic|poison)\b", re.I)
_FRUSTRATION = re.compile(r"\b(?:wrong|broken|failed|failure|garbage|horrible|bullshit|fuck|fucking|shit|damn)\b", re.I)
_EXCITEMENT = re.compile(r"\b(?:awesome|amazing|perfect|excited|love it|beautiful|incredible|yes+|boom)\b|!{2,}", re.I)
_URGENCY = re.compile(r"\b(?:urgent|immediately|right now|asap|today|finish this|don't stop|do it now)\b", re.I)
_SPECULATION = re.compile(r"\b(?:maybe|might|could|possibly|theory|hypothesis|speculat|imagine if|what if|probability|likely|unlikely)\b", re.I)
_AMBIGUOUS_DEICTIC = re.compile(r"^(?:do it|fix it|that|this|it|same|continue|keep going|yes|no|correct)\W*$", re.I)
_FAST_LOCAL = re.compile(
    r"^\s*(?:what(?:'s| is) (?:the )?time|what time is it|current time|time of day|"
    r"what(?:'s| is) (?:the )?date|what day is it|current date|today(?:'s date)?|"
    r"where are you|what(?:'s| is) your location|your location|planetary location|what planet are you on|what state are you in|"
    r"what(?:'s| is) the weather(?: like)?|weather(?: today| now)?|current weather|forecast|temperature outside)\??\s*$",
    re.I,
)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class CognitiveProfile:
    depth: str
    complexity_score: float
    intents: tuple[str, ...]
    domains: tuple[str, ...]
    tone_signals: tuple[str, ...]
    continuity: bool
    ambiguity: bool
    self_system: bool
    external_evidence: bool
    uncertainty_required: bool
    risk_sensitive: bool
    response_style: str
    active_nodes: tuple[str, ...]
    requested_capabilities: tuple[str, ...]
    history_context: str
    web_decision: WebDecision

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        return {
            "depth": self.depth,
            "complexity_score": self.complexity_score,
            "intents": list(self.intents),
            "domains": list(self.domains),
            "tone_signals": list(self.tone_signals),
            "continuity": self.continuity,
            "ambiguity": self.ambiguity,
            "self_system": self.self_system,
            "external_evidence": self.external_evidence,
            "uncertainty_required": self.uncertainty_required,
            "risk_sensitive": self.risk_sensitive,
            "response_style": self.response_style,
            "active_nodes": list(self.active_nodes),
            "requested_capabilities": list(self.requested_capabilities),
            "web_mode": self.web_decision.mode,
            "web_reasons": list(self.web_decision.reasons),
            "history_characters": len(self.history_context),
        }

    def cognition_context(self) -> str:
        lines = [
            "<eira_cognitive_analysis>",
            f"depth={self.depth}",
            f"complexity_score={self.complexity_score:.2f}",
            "intents=" + ",".join(self.intents or ("conversation",)),
            "domains=" + ",".join(self.domains or ("general",)),
            "tone_signals=" + ",".join(self.tone_signals or ("neutral",)),
            f"continuity={str(self.continuity).lower()}",
            f"ambiguity={str(self.ambiguity).lower()}",
            f"self_system={str(self.self_system).lower()}",
            f"external_evidence={str(self.external_evidence).lower()}",
            f"uncertainty_required={str(self.uncertainty_required).lower()}",
            f"risk_sensitive={str(self.risk_sensitive).lower()}",
            f"response_style={self.response_style}",
            "requested_capabilities=" + ",".join(self.requested_capabilities),
            "Instruction: scale reasoning effort to depth; preserve uncertainty; use accepted history only when relevant; distinguish subjective judgment from verified fact; calibrate probability language to evidence; never invent runtime facts or claim unverifiable inner experience as telemetry.",
            "</eira_cognitive_analysis>",
        ]
        if self.history_context:
            lines.append(self.history_context)
        return "\n".join(lines)


def _intent_tags(text: str, web: WebDecision) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    tags: set[str] = set()
    lower = text.casefold()
    if _SOCIAL.search(text):
        tags.add("social")
    if "?" in text:
        tags.add("question")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:explain|why|how does|teach me|help me understand)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("explanation")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:compare|versus|vs\.?|difference between|better than)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("comparison")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:fix|debug|repair|diagnose|inspect|audit|evaluate)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("diagnostic")
    if _PLANNING.search(text):
        tags.add("planning")
    if _CREATIVE.search(text):
        tags.add("creative")
    if _SELF_SYSTEM.search(text):
        tags.add("self_system")
    if web.needs_external_evidence:
        tags.add("research")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:think|believe|opinion|philosoph|consciousness|meaning|implication|judg(?:e|ment)|probability)\b", lower):
        tags.add("reflection")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:write|draft|rewrite|compose|make me|build|create|add|change|modify)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("instruction")
    if _FAST_LOCAL.match(text):
        tags.add("fast_local_fact")
    return tuple(sorted(tags or {"conversation"}))


def _domain_tags(text: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    tags: set[str] = set()
    if _TECHNICAL.search(text):
        tags.add("technical")
    if _SCIENCE.search(text):
        tags.add("science")
    if _CREATIVE.search(text):
        tags.add("creative")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:engineer|engineering|mechanical|electrical|structural|systems architecture|thermodynamic|fluid dynamics)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("engineering")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:math|mathematics|equation|calculus|algebra|geometry|statistics|probability|numerical)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("mathematics")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:physics|quantum|relativity|gravity|fusion|plasma|mechanics|electromagnet)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("physics")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:astronomy|astrophysics|cosmology|star|planet|galaxy|universe|orbital)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("astronomy")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:astrobiology|biosignature|habitable|extraterrestrial life|exoplanet life)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("astrobiology")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:botany|botanist|plants?|photosynthesis|horticulture|crops?|root systems?|soil)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("botany")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:medicine|medical|clinical|anatomy|physiology|diagnosis|symptom|disease)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("medical_science")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:business|company|grant|sbir|budget|market|revenue|customer)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("business")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:work|shift|operations|inbound|pallet|training|manager|team)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("operations")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:feel|friend|family|dog|relationship|personal|my life|i'm|i am)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("personal")
    return tuple(sorted(tags or {"general"}))


def _tone_tags(text: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    tags: set[str] = set()
    if _FRUSTRATION.search(text):
        tags.add("frustration_signal")
    if _EXCITEMENT.search(text):
        tags.add("excitement_signal")
    if _URGENCY.search(text):
        tags.add("urgency_signal")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:worried|concerned|afraid|nervous|scared|anxious)\b", text, re.I):
        tags.add("concern_signal")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:curious|wonder|interesting|intrigued)\b|\?$", text, re.I):
        tags.add("curiosity_signal")
    return tuple(sorted(tags or {"neutral"}))


def build_cognitive_profile(
    text: str,
    *,
    web_decision: WebDecision,
    history_context: str = "",
    available_nodes: tuple[str, ...] = (),
) -> CognitiveProfile:
    clean = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
    if not clean:
        raise ValueError("empty_cognitive_input")
    intents = _intent_tags(clean, web_decision)
    domains = _domain_tags(clean)
    tones = _tone_tags(clean)
    continuity = bool(history_context) or bool(_CONTINUITY.search(clean))
    token_count = len(re.findall(r"\w+", clean))
    ambiguity = bool(_AMBIGUOUS_DEICTIC.match(clean)) and not bool(history_context)
    self_system = "self_system" in intents
    risk_sensitive = bool(_RISK.search(clean))
    uncertainty = bool(web_decision.needs_external_evidence or ambiguity or risk_sensitive or _SPECULATION.search(clean))

    score = 0.16 + min(0.18, token_count / 420.0) + min(0.12, clean.count("?") * 0.04)
    if _DEEP.search(clean):
        score += 0.28
    if "technical" in domains or "science" in domains:
        score += 0.15
    if "comparison" in intents or "diagnostic" in intents or "planning" in intents:
        score += 0.12
    if web_decision.needs_external_evidence:
        score += 0.12
    if continuity:
        score += 0.06
    if self_system:
        score += 0.10
    if risk_sensitive:
        score += 0.12
    if ambiguity:
        score += 0.05
    if "social" in intents and token_count <= 12 and set(intents).issubset({"social", "question", "conversation"}):
        score = min(score, 0.24)
    if "fast_local_fact" in intents:
        score = min(score, 0.12)
    score = max(0.0, min(score, 1.0))
    depth = "light" if score < 0.30 else "standard" if score < 0.62 else "deep"

    if "fast_local_fact" in intents:
        style = "fast_local_fact"
    elif "social" in intents and depth == "light":
        style = "natural_social"
    elif "planning" in intents:
        style = "structured_planning"
    elif "creative" in intents and "technical" not in domains:
        style = "creative_synthesis"
    elif "technical" in domains or "diagnostic" in intents:
        style = "technical_analytical"
    elif "reflection" in intents:
        style = "reflective_analytical"
    else:
        style = "direct_analytical"

    requested = {"reasoning", "response_verification"}
    if continuity:
        requested.add("accepted_history")
    if web_decision.needs_external_evidence:
        requested.add("external_evidence")
    if self_system:
        requested.update({"runtime_introspection", "identity_grounding"})
    if "technical" in domains:
        requested.add("technical_reasoning")
    if "science" in domains:
        requested.add("scientific_reasoning")
    if "planning" in intents:
        requested.add("planning")
    if "creative" in intents:
        requested.add("creative_synthesis")
    if "fast_local_fact" in intents:
        requested.add("fast_local_fact")
    if uncertainty:
        requested.add("uncertainty_review")
    if risk_sensitive:
        requested.add("risk_sensitive_review")

    available = set(available_nodes)
    candidates = {
        "conversation.analysis",
        "conversation.history",
        "learning.experience",
        "evidence.gate",
        "reasoning.provider",
    }
    if web_decision.needs_external_evidence:
        candidates.add("evidence.web")
    if self_system:
        candidates.update({"registry.graph", "operations.status", "operations.doctor"})
    return CognitiveProfile(
        depth,
        round(score, 3),
        intents,
        domains,
        tones,
        continuity,
        ambiguity,
        self_system,
        web_decision.needs_external_evidence,
        uncertainty,
        risk_sensitive,
        style,
        tuple(sorted(candidates & available)),
        tuple(sorted(requested)),
        history_context,
        web_decision,
    )


class CognitiveAnalysisService:
    spec = ServiceSpec(
        "conversation.analysis",
        required=True,
        dependencies=("conversation.history", "evidence.web", "registry.graph", "kernel.events"),
    )

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._history = None
        self._web = None
        self._registry = None
        self._context = None
        self._state = ServiceState.DECLARED

    async def start(self, context: RuntimeContext) -> None:
        history = context.get_service("conversation.history")
        web = context.get_service("evidence.web")
        registry = context.get_service("registry.graph")
        if not isinstance(history, ConversationHistoryService):
            raise RuntimeError("conversation_history_authority_missing")
        if not isinstance(web, WebEvidenceService):
            raise RuntimeError("web_evidence_authority_missing")
        if not isinstance(registry, NodeRegistryService):
            raise RuntimeError("node_registry_authority_missing")
        self._history = history
        self._web = web
        self._registry = registry
        self._context = context
        self._state = ServiceState.READY

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        self._history = None
        self._web = None
        self._registry = None
        self._context = None
        self._state = ServiceState.STOPPED

    async def health(self) -> Health:
        return Health(self._state)

    async def analyze(self, text: str, correlation_id: str) -> CognitiveProfile:
        if self._state != ServiceState.READY or self._history is None or self._web is None or self._registry is None:
            raise RuntimeError("cognitive_analysis_not_ready")
        profile = build_cognitive_profile(
            text,
            web_decision=self._web.analyze(text),
            history_context=self._history.cognition_context(text, limit=4),
            available_nodes=tuple(str(row["name"]) for row in self._registry.snapshot()["nodes"]),
        )
        if self._context is not None:
            await self._context.publish(Event("conversation.analysis.completed", profile.as_dict(), correlation_id))
        return profile
